Orange-pink Grandiflora.
Registration name: WEKabacima
Exhibition name: Uptown Girl™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tom Carruth (United States, 2011).
Introduced in Australia by Swane's Nursery/Swane Bros Pty Ltd in 2022 as 'Macushla'.
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2022 as 'Uptown Girl'.
rows.Bloom: Coral-pink, darker center, coral-pink reverse. Flowers coral-pink with an coral orange heart; reverse coral-pink. Moderate, fruity, spice fragrance. 70 to 90 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, very full (41+ petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, rounded, upright. Large, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 31" to 47" (80 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden.
